title: Factor site content and newsroom into submodules with S3 publish path

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Epic scope: (1) extract src/blog to AnthusAI/anthus-blog-content submodule at same path; (2) mount anthus-semantic-knowledge-base at newsroom/; (3) Amplify submodule init; (4) content-repo GitHub Action to sync MDX/images to S3 and optionally trigger site rebuild. Goal: decouple content pushes from full 30min site deploys.
